title: Shared flow policy (flows/_shared.json)
description: Policy every flow shares (design §5.2, contract §5, §9, §12): cap defaults, the high-risk lexicon, test globs, the `sdlc run` allowlist with its script names and exit-code meanings, and the runtime capability rows. scripts/sdlc_runner/manifest.validate_shared adds: loop_max_rounds <= loop_hard_max_rounds, runtime ids are the known eight, no lexicon term under two surfaces, every glob inside the fingerprint.py dialect, every allowlist entry reachable and script_after within subcommand, inner and insert_args only on wrapping entries (inner naming listed programs) and the argument rules only on the others, exit_codes keyed by allowlist runner ids with fail and invalid disjoint.

caps.description: Design §5.11 defaults: max_visits per step (implement and strategy differ), the per-run transition cap, the no-progress count, loop rounds (default and hard ceiling), loop role re-entries per round, security fix rounds.

risk_lexicon.description: The eight high-risk surfaces of design D8, each with English terms. A request that matches a term needs --risk high or a --risk-reason at start (design §5.3). Terms are lowercase words separated by single spaces; match them case-insensitively as whole words, a space matching any run of whitespace or a hyphen.

test_globs.description: Changed paths matching any glob are tests; every other changed path outside docs/agentic-sdlc/** is source (contract §5). Dialect of scripts/sdlc_runner/fingerprint.py: POSIX paths relative to the project root, ** as a whole segment, * and ? within a segment, {a,b} alternatives, case-sensitive.

ignore_globs.description: Changed paths matching any glob are left out of every named set (contract §5, beside docs/agentic-sdlc/** and .git/**): tool caches and bytecode a test or check run writes, which are no source change of the work. Same dialect as test_globs.

run_allowlist.description: The (program, subcommand) pairs `sdlc run` executes (contract §12). Entries are tried in order and the first whose program and subcommand match decides; nothing else runs. program: a bare name resolved on PATH, or ./name for a launcher that must resolve in the run's directory inside the project. subcommand (optional): the first argument(s) must equal one of these, a value with spaces being a token sequence ("-3 -m"); absent, any arguments. script_after: after one of these subcommands the next token must match a run_scripts name. wraps: the tokens right after the matched subcommand (or right after the program) are an inner command, checked against this list again; the wrapper's own options are not accepted before it. inner (wrapping entries): the programs the inner command may name. insert_args (wrapping entries): tokens the runner places right after the wrapper and its subcommand. module_only: matches only as the module after a -m subcommand of a wrapping entry. runner: the exit_codes key (default: the program without ./); a wrapping entry takes its inner command's runner. deny_args: tokens refused anywhere in the arguments, as given, as token=value, or (a long option) as a prefix of two or more letters. deny_prefixes: an argument starting with one is refused (@file argument files). deny_vars: make-style variable assignments refused as arguments (NAME=, NAME:=, NAME+=, ...). path_flags: flags whose value must be a path inside the project (they load code or configuration), in every spelling including a long-option prefix of three or more letters.

run_scripts.description: Package scripts `npm|pnpm|yarn run <script>` may name; * matches within the name (test:* matches test:unit).

exit_codes.description: Runner id -> the exit codes that mean a test failure (a valid RED) and those that mean the run itself is invalid (usage error, nothing collected, crash). A code in neither list is invalid for a listed runner; a runner not listed here counts every non-zero code as a failure.

escalation.description: Design §5.11 escalate lattice, upward only (light -> gated is a form change, not an edge). from and to are flow ids; work_type is the work type the target flow runs with: "keep" carries the package's own (it must be one of the target's work types), any other value replaces it (test -> feature runs as feature). manifest.validate_shared refuses a duplicate or self edge; manifest.validate_lattice checks the edges against the flow manifests (known flows, work types the target runs with an implement variant, no cycle).

runtimes.description: Contract §9 capability rows; the strategy rule table maps them to the default map. workflow: native engine, a staged script, only on the user's explicit request (never a default), or none. freshness names the card text variant for fresh role sub-agents. verified stays false until a live run backs the row.
